tasks.label: ⚡ Update Extensions List
tasks.detail: Updates src/.vscode/extensions.txt with your currently installed extensions.

tasks.label: 🧪 Open Playground
tasks.detail: Opens the playground file to test fonts and colors.

tasks.label: 📦 Smart Install Deps
tasks.command: if [ -f 'package.json' ]; then npm install; elif [ -f 'requirements.txt' ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; elif [ -f 'pom.xml' ]; then mvn install; elif [ -f 'Cargo.toml' ]; then cargo build; else echo '❌ No supported dependency file found (package.json, requirements.txt, pom.xml, Cargo.toml)'; fi
tasks.detail: Detects the project type (Node, Python, Java, Rust) and installs dependencies automatically.

tasks.label: 🚀 Start Local Server
tasks.detail: Serves the current directory on http://localhost:8000 using Python.

tasks.label: 🔍 Find TODOs
tasks.detail: Scans the entire project for TODO and FIXME comments, ignoring common build folders.

tasks.label: 💀 Kill Process on Port...
tasks.detail: Force kills any process running on the specified port (useful for stuck servers).

tasks.label: 🔄 Git Sync (Pull & Push)
tasks.detail: Pulls remote changes (rebase) and pushes your current branch.
